title: Catboat Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: Within the two spacious living areas, relaxation and entertainment blend seamlessly. On the first floor, the inviting dining area transitions into a place of leisure, complete with comfortable seating, an HDTV, and a convenient kitchenette for snacking pleasure. Yet the true gem on this level might be the primary suite, where tranquility reigns. The master bath, with its custom-tiled walk-in shower, spacious sunken tub, and stylish dual-sink vanity, promises a haven of peace and rejuvenation. And the guest bedrooms? Each one is a unique retreat, offering a blend of comfort and luxury, from king beds to cozy bunk setups, each with its own en-suite bathroom designed for utmost convenience and relaxation. Indulge in the ultimate luxury getaway at this stunning vacation home, where every detail has been meticulously crafted to pamper and impress. The kitchen is more than just a place to prepare meals; it's a culinary dream, boasting full custom cabinetry, elegant granite countertops, and state-of-the-art Viking stainless steel appliances. Adjacent to this chef's haven, a charming breakfast nook provides the perfect setting to enjoy morning delights, while the elegant dining area stands ready to host those special gatherings, accommodating up to eight guests in an atmosphere of grace and sophistication.
